intro: This policy explains what Eat Rrite collects when you book a consultation or contact us, why, who it is shared with, how long it is kept, and how to withdraw your consent or ask for your data to be deleted.

sections.title: What we collect
items: Your name, email address and mobile number, when you book or contact us.
Your answers to the health questionnaire you fill in after booking.
Payment confirmation details from the payment provider. We never see or store your card or bank details.

sections.title: Why we collect it
items: To arrange your consultation, send your Google Meet link and remind you before it.
To prepare a nutrition plan that fits your health, reports and routine.
To reply when you message or call us.

sections.title: Who it is shared with
items: Google, for the Meet link, calendar and email.
Meta, for WhatsApp messages about your consultation.
Razorpay, the payment provider, for the ₹800 confirmation fee.
No one else. We never sell your data.

sections.title: Health answers
items: Your questionnaire answers are treated as sensitive. They are stored securely, never sent in plain email, and only Mukta can see them.
Health details are never used in advertising or tracking.

sections.title: How long we keep it
items: For as long as you are a client, and then only as long as needed for our records, after which it is deleted.

sections.title: Your choices
items: You can withdraw your consent, see the data we hold, correct it, or ask us to delete it at any time.
Write to info@eatrrite.com or message us on WhatsApp. We reply within a few working days.

sections.title: Complaints
items: Mukta Patil, founder of Eat Rrite, is responsible for your data. Email info@eatrrite.com or call +91 96398 77483.
